findings: host_processes provides bounded PID/name/uid/start identity and deliberately omits argv; no given-PID executable/cgroup/unit mapping is specified.
network_inspect supplies host network public identity but has only a host argument and is not a PID/start-bound executable lookup.
service_status requires exact service/unit/label names; none is known for PID2031533, so no guessed names are submitted.
process_checkpoint belongs to the administrator-pinned CRIU family and is explicitly excluded by root. It is not used as an inventory workaround.
The proposed single explicit Python job has only fixed proc paths and no target control. Native execution requires a separate exact GO.
